mapper.sql: CAST(tc.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(tc.course_id AS CHAR) courseId,tc.name,c.name courseName,tc.semester,tc.location,tc.notes,tc.created_at createdAt,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_member m WHERE m.class_id=tc.id) studentCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teaching_class tc JOIN course c ON c.id=tc.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND tc.archived=0 AND c.id=#{courseId} ORDER BY c.sort_order,tc.id
SELECT FROM teaching_class tc JOIN course c ON c.id=tc.course_id WHERE tc.id=#{id} AND c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND tc.archived=0

SELECT CAST(tc.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(tc.course_id AS CHAR) courseId FROM teaching_class tc JOIN course c ON c.id=tc.course_id WHERE tc.id=#{id} AND c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND tc.archived=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) id,u.username,u.real_name realName,u.enabled,m.joined_at joinedAt FROM class_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id=m.student_id WHERE m.class_id=#{id} ORDER BY u.username

SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) id,u.username,u.real_name realName FROM course_enrollment e JOIN app_user u ON u.id=e.student_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND u.role='STUDENT' AND u.enabled=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM class_member m WHERE m.course_id=e.course_id AND m.student_id=e.student_id) ORDER BY u.username
SELECT class_id FROM class_member WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_member WHERE class_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
